items.title: Gallagher Expands Texas Employee Benefits Operations via Mund Group Deal
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. has acquired Texas-based employee benefits agency Mund Group, Ltd.

items.title: APAC cedents seeking holistic solutions beyond pure volatility cover, says Marsh Re's Tony Gallagher
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that insurance cedents across the Asia Pacific region are increasingly looking for holistic solutions and earnings protection amid frequent secondary catastrophe perils, according to Marsh Re's Tony Gallagher.

items.title: Allison Reagan joins CRC Specialty as SVP, Property Broker
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that CRC Specialty has appointed Allison Reagan as Senior Vice President and Property Broker.

items.title: Pennsylvania Court Upholds $815M Judgment Against Exxon in Mechanic Benzene Case
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that a three-judge panel of the Superior Court of Pennsylvania has rejected an appeal by Exxon Mobil Corp. regarding an $815.5 million compensatory damages judgment.

items.title: PG&E Considers Gas Business Separation Amid California Wildfire Liability Rules
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that PG&E Corp. may spin off or sell its natural gas business unless California reforms its wildfire liability regulations.

items.title: Verdant Rock secures dual-agency coverage with Morningstar DBRS credit rating
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Bermuda-domiciled Class 3B insurer Verdant Rock Limited has been awarded an A (low) Financial Strength Rating and an A (low) Issuer Rating by Morningstar DBRS.
